description: Counts the venue's realized LOSSES against the daily risk counters. A trade closed by the VENUE's own stop never goes through the close path, so without this the daily loss cap can never fire on it. Idempotent: each venue trade is counted exactly once, tracked in the realized-PnL ledger. Never moves funds, never places an order. Returns how many trades were counted, the loss recorded, and what was skipped and why.

connectionId.description: CEX connection id (see list_connections). Takes precedence over exchange.

days.description: How far back to reconcile, in days, 1..30 (default 2)

exchange.description: CEX slug, e.g. kucoin (resolved to an active connection; connectionId wins when both are given)

name: reconcile_realized_pnl
title: Reconcile realized PnL against the daily loss cap
